planting.note: Set out container-grown plants in fall or spring in average, well-drained soil in full sun to partial shade; Plena needs several years to reach its full upright, arching size and resents being crowded by neighboring shrubs.

directions: This old double-flowered selection of fuzzy deutzia bears dense, upright panicles packed with rounded, rose-flushed white blossoms in late spring to early summer, a fuller and showier display than the single five-petaled flowers of the wild species. The rough, sandpaper-textured leaves typical of the species turn an undistinguished yellow-green in fall, but after a few seasons the arching stems develop peeling, cinnamon-brown bark that extends the shrub's interest into winter. Renewal-prune a portion of the oldest canes to the ground right after flowering to keep the clump from becoming congested and twiggy over time.
